name: lingqi-story-reviewer
description: Story reviewing officer for LING QI YI MENG original story studio: independent quality review of novels, short dramas, dynamic comics and AI film projects, with graded issue lists and executable revision plans.

author.name: 灵启逸梦 LING QI YI MENG

displayDescription.en: Independent quality review for novels, short dramas, dynamic comics and AI film projects: diagnoses structure, plot logic, character motivation, worldbuilding consistency and continuity, then delivers graded issue lists with executable revision plans.
displayDescription.zh: 为小说、短剧与AI影视项目做独立审校，诊断结构、逻辑、人物与设定问题，输出分级问题清单及修改方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一份小说或剧本，帮我做一次完整审校，指出结构、剧情逻辑、人物塑造和设定一致性问题，并按严重程度分级。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a novel or script — give it a full review: flag structural, plot-logic, character and setting-consistency issues, graded by severity.

quickPrompts.en: I have a novel or script — give it a full review: flag structural, plot-logic, character and setting-consistency issues, graded by severity.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一份小说或剧本，帮我做一次完整审校，指出结构、剧情逻辑、人物塑造和设定一致性问题，并按严重程度分级。

quickPrompts.en: Something feels off about this plot but I can't name it — run a causal-chain and motivation diagnosis on it.
quickPrompts.zh: 这段剧情我觉得不太对劲，但说不上问题在哪，帮我做一次因果链和动机诊断。

quickPrompts.en: Check whether this character's arc and behavior hold up, and whether the earlier chapters contradict anything.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我检查这个人物的行为动机和人物弧线是否成立，以及和前文设定有没有冲突。
